# Ory Elements override slots

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-slot-map.ts from the OryFlowComponents type. Do not edit. -->

Every part of the UI that `@ory/elements-react` renders is a slot of the `OryFlowComponents` type. Replace a slot by passing a component under the same path in the `components` prop of a flow component (`OryFlowComponentOverrides`). A slot that you don't pass keeps its default component.

This file lists all 36 slots of the installed version. A path that is not listed here does not exist. The same data is in `slots.json` next to this file.

```tsx
<Login
  flow={flow}
  config={config}
  components={{ Card: { Header: MyCardHeader }, Node: { Button: MyButton } }}
/>
```

A replacement component receives the props type listed for its slot. Import the props types from `@ory/elements-react`, and the default components that are marked as exported from `@ory/elements-react/theme`.

## Node

| Slot | Props type | Default component | Rendered |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Node.Button` | `OryNodeButtonProps` | `DefaultButton` (internal) | Button component, rendered whenever a button is encountered in the Ory UI Nodes. |
| `Node.SsoButton` | `OryNodeSsoButtonProps` | `DefaultButtonSocial` (exported) | The SsoButton component is rendered whenever a button of group "oidc" or "saml" node is encountered. It renders the "Login with Google", "Login with Facebook" etc. buttons. |
| `Node.Anchor` | `OryNodeAnchorProps` | `DefaultLinkButton` (internal) | Anchor component, rendered whenever an "anchor" node is encountered |
| `Node.Input` | `OryNodeInputProps` | `DefaultInput` (internal) | The Input component is rendered whenever a "input" node is encountered. |
| `Node.Select` (optional) | `OryNodeSelectProps` | `DefaultSelect` (internal) | The Select component is rendered whenever an "input" node declares a non-empty `options` list, typically the result of an `enum` constraint in the identity schema. Optional for backward compatibility: when not provided, the dispatch falls back to the regular `Input` renderer so older consumers that constructed `OryFlowComponents` by hand keep compiling and rendering. |
| `Node.CodeInput` | `OryNodeInputProps` | `DefaultPinCodeInput` (internal) | Special version of the Input component for OTP codes. |
| `Node.Image` | `OryNodeImageProps` | `DefaultImage` (internal) | The Image component is rendered whenever an "image" node is encountered. For example used in the "Logo" node. |
| `Node.Label` | `OryNodeLabelProps` | `DefaultLabel` (internal) | The Label component is rendered around Input components and is used to render form labels. |
| `Node.Checkbox` | `OryNodeCheckboxProps` | `DefaultCheckbox` (internal) | The Checkbox component is rendered whenever an input node with of boolean type is encountered. |
| `Node.Text` | `OryNodeTextProps` | `DefaultText` (internal) | The Text component is rendered whenever a "text" node is encountered. |
| `Node.Captcha` | `OryNodeCaptchaProps` | `DefaultCaptcha` (internal) | The Captcha component is rendered whenever a "captcha" group is encountered. |
| `Node.ConsentScopeCheckbox` | `OryNodeConsentScopeCheckboxProps` | `DefaultConsentScopeCheckbox` (internal) | Special version of the Input component for scopes in OAuth2 flows. |

## Card

| Slot | Props type | Default component | Rendered |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Card.Root` | `OryCardProps` | `DefaultCard` (exported) | The card container is the main container of the card. |
| `Card.Footer` | `OryCardFooterProps` | `DefaultCardFooter` (exported) | The card footer is the footer of the card container. |
| `Card.Header` | `OryCardProps` | `DefaultCardHeader` (exported) | The card header is the header of the card container. |
| `Card.Content` | `OryCardContentProps` | `DefaultCardContent` (exported) | The card content is the main content of the card container. |
| `Card.Logo` | `OryCardLogoProps` | `DefaultCardLogo` (exported) | The card logo is the logo of the card container. |
| `Card.Divider` | `OryCardDividerProps` | `DefaultHorizontalDivider` (internal) | The HorizontalDivider component is rendered between groups. |
| `Card.AuthMethodListContainer` | `PropsWithChildren` | `DefaultAuthMethodListContainer` (internal) | The AuthMethodListContainer component is rendered around the "method" chooser step in the identifier_first login flow. This is only used, if login is configured to use identifier_first authentication. |
| `Card.AuthMethodListItem` | `OryCardAuthMethodListItemProps` | `DefaultAuthMethodListItem` (internal) | The AuthMethodListItem component is rendered on the "method" chooser step in the identifier_first login flow. This is only used, if login is configured to use identifier_first authentication. |
| `Card.SettingsSection` | `OryCardSettingsSectionProps` | `DefaultFormSection` (internal) | The SettingsSection component is rendered around each section of the settings. |
| `Card.SettingsSectionContent` | `OryFormSectionContentProps` | `DefaultFormSectionContent` (internal) | The SettingsSectionContent component is rendered around the content of each section of the settings. |
| `Card.SettingsSectionFooter` | `OryFormSectionFooterProps` | `DefaultFormSectionFooter` (internal) | The SettingsSectionFooter component is rendered around the footer of each section of the settings. |

## Form

| Slot | Props type | Default component | Rendered |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Form.Root` | `OryFormRootProps` | `DefaultFormContainer` (exported) | The FormContainer component is the main container of the form. It should render its children. You most likely don't want to override this component directly. |
| `Form.SsoRoot` | `OryFormSsoRootProps` | `DefaultSocialButtonContainer` (internal) | A special form group container for the social buttons. This is required, because the social buttons need to be in its form, to not influence the other form groups. You most likely don't want to override this component directly. |
| `Form.Group` | `OryFormGroupProps` | `DefaultGroupContainer` (internal) | The FormGroup is rendered around each group of nodes in the UI nodes. |
| `Form.SsoSettings` | `OrySettingsSsoProps` | `DefaultSettingsOidc` (internal) | The section on the settings page, rendering the OIDC settings |
| `Form.WebauthnSettings` | `OrySettingsWebauthnProps` | `DefaultSettingsWebauthn` (internal) | The section on the settings page, rendering the Webauthn settings |
| `Form.DeviceauthnSettings` | `OrySettingsDeviceauthnProps` | `DefaultSettingsDeviceauthn` (internal) | The section on the settings page, rendering the DeviceAuthn settings. |
| `Form.PasskeySettings` | `OrySettingsPasskeyProps` | `DefaultSettingsPasskey` (internal) | The section on the settings page, rendering the Passkey settings |
| `Form.TotpSettings` | `OrySettingsTotpProps` | `DefaultSettingsTotp` (internal) | The section on the settings page, rendering the TOTP settings |
| `Form.RecoveryCodesSettings` | `OrySettingsRecoveryCodesProps` | `DefaultSettingsRecoveryCodes` (internal) | The section on the settings page, rendering the recovery code settings |
